question: If in a certain code, INTERNET is written as TENRETNI, then in the same code, REMEMBER would be written as:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic is:

Letters are written from right end to left end.

INTERNET → TENRETNI 

Similarly,

REMEMBER → REBMEMER

Hence, ‘**REBMEMER**’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**The logic follows here is:
